jobs.title: SVP & General Manager - Caesars Atlantic City
jobs.description:
At Caesars Atlantic City, we are seeking a visionary and results-driven Senior Vice President & General Manager to lead one of the industry's most iconic brands. This is an opportunity to shape the future of a premier gaming, hospitality, entertainment, and resort destination while driving exceptional business performance, luxury guest experiences, and dynamic team engagement.
As the property's senior executive leader, the SVP & GM is responsible for creating and executing the strategic vision for Caesars Atlantic City. This role oversees all aspects of resort operations, including gaming, hotel, food and beverage, marketing, finance, human resources, retail, and guest experience. The successful leader will inspire high-performing teams, champion innovation, build strong community partnerships, and deliver sustainable growth in revenue, profitability, and market share.
This position demands a dynamic executive who is equally comfortable setting long-term strategy in the boardroom and engaging with guests and team members throughout the property.
You are a strategic business leader with a proven track record of leading complex, customer-centric operations. You thrive in high-visibility environments, inspire teams to achieve ambitious goals, and possess the business acumen to drive sustainable growth in a highly regulated industry.

Preferred Qualifications
•    10+ years of progressive executive leadership experience with substantial P&L responsibility in hospitality, gaming, entertainment, tourism, or related industries.
•    Proven experience leading large, multi-functional operations and diverse leadership teams.
•    Strong understanding of gaming operations, resort management, customer loyalty, and revenue optimization.
•    Demonstrated success driving growth, profitability, and operational transformation.
•    Exceptional financial, analytical, and strategic planning capabilities.
•    Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
•    Experience partnering with government officials, community leaders, labor organizations, and corporate executives.
•    Ability to navigate complex regulatory environments while maintaining the highest ethical standards.

Why Caesars Atlantic City
This is more than a General Manager role. It is an opportunity to shape the future of a landmark destination, influence the experience of millions of guests, lead thousands of team members, and leave a lasting impact on one of Atlantic City's most recognized brands.
If you are a transformational leader who is passionate about hospitality, gaming, people, and performance, we invite you to join us and lead Caesars Atlantic City into its next chapter of growth and success.
Drive Business Performance & Strategic Growth
•    Develop and execute the property's long-term strategic plan, annual operating plan, and capital investment strategy.
•    Lead efforts to maximize revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.
•    Identify emerging trends, competitive opportunities, and innovative growth strategies that strengthen Caesars Atlantic City's position in the market.
•    Partner closely with corporate leadership to align property performance with enterprise goals.

Create Exceptional Guest Experiences
•    Champion a culture of service excellence that consistently exceeds guest expectations.
•    Ensure seamless delivery of world-class gaming, hospitality, dining, entertainment, and resort experiences.
•    Maintain a visible presence throughout the property, building relationships with guests and serving as a brand ambassador.
•    Lead customer engagement initiatives, VIP events, promotions, and community-facing experiences that deepen loyalty and drive visitation.

Build and Inspire High-Performing Teams
•    Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional executive talent across all functions.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusiveness, and continuous improvement.
•    Coach senior leaders to achieve outstanding results while creating meaningful career growth opportunities for team members.
•    Serve as a highly visible and approachable leader who promotes engagement and organizational pride.

Strengthen Community & Stakeholder Relationships
•    Represent Caesars Atlantic City with local government officials, community organizations, tourism partners, business leaders, and industry stakeholders.
•    Serve as the property's primary spokesperson and executive representative.
•    Build productive relationships with union leadership and key external partners.
•    Enhance Caesars' reputation as a trusted corporate citizen and employer of choice within the community.

Champion Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Ensure all operations are conducted with the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and responsible business practices.
•    Lead a culture that prioritizes regulatory excellence, risk management, and ethical decision-making.
•    Maintain exceptional standards of facility presentation, cleanliness, safety, and guest satisfaction through consistent operational oversight.
•    Promote an environment where team members feel empowered to speak up, share ideas, and raise concerns.

jobs.title: Casino Operations Manager-Table Games-Full Time (Harrah's Ak-Chin Casino)
jobs.description:
The Casino Operations Manager provides leadership and oversees the Casino activities relating to Table Games.
- Bachelor’s degree (BA) or equivalent; or four to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience with at least 3 years of progressive gaming operations experience.

- Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors.

- Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

- Skill in reading, analyzing and interpreting common scientific and technical journals, financial reports and legal documents.

- Skill in responding to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies or members of the business community.

- Skill with mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity; analysis of variance; correlation techniques; sampling theory and factor analysis.

- Skill in defining problems, collecting data, establishing facts and drawing valid conclusions.

-  Must be willing to approach and converse with strangers.

- Must be able to bend, reach, kneel, twist and grip items.

- Must be able to walk and be on foot for long periods of time.

- Must have sense of urgency and keep up with fast-paced business practices.

- Must be able to work calmly and professionally in stressful situations.

- Must be able to tolerate areas containing secondary smoke, high noise levels, bright lights and dust.

- Must be able to respond to visual and aural cues.
- Develops, implements and monitors progress of short and long-term goals for the Table Games department.

- Coordinates activities of Table Games with other departments to ensure total customer satisfaction.

- Directs, coordinates and analyzes products, services and operations to ensure maximum profitability and efficiency by continually updating game mix.

- Analyzes department budgets requests to identify areas in which reductions can be made and allocates operating budget.

- Confers with administrative personnel and reviews activity, operating and mix reports to determine changes in programs or operations required.

- Promote organization in industry, manufacturing or trade associations.

- Is responsible for developing and executing annual business plans and budgets for the Table Games department.

- Maintains monthly budget, justifying unusual variances while providing monthly status report.

- Trains, counsels and coaches assigned personnel to the performance of their duties; prepares and presents Performance Appraisal Reviews.

- Ensures compliance with tribal, state and company requirements.

- Maintains professional skills by staying abreast of current technical developments and participation in developmental programs available within and outside the company.

- Responsible for monitoring legal compliance with federal, state and gaming laws.

- Champion, within the organization, a commitment to honesty, integrity, and responsible corporate behavior.

- Create a compliance culture within the organization and foster an environment where employees feel comfortable reporting potential violations or misconduct.

- Adheres to regulatory, departmental and company policies

- Is responsible for all aspects of promotions and/or special projects relating to department personnel.

- Is responsible for resolving both guest and employee conflict situations in a way that is consistent with Harrah’s Company Policies and State Gaming Compact.

- Develop implements and coordinates short and long-range objectives including marketing promotions, gaming-related events and tournaments to increase Harrah’s share of the high-quality gaming customer market.

- Develops customer development culture throughout the casino through strategic efforts and teamwork.

- Maintains and submits required records and reports and maintains the confidential nature of matters pertaining to company records.

- Maintains security of all games, monies and personnel.

- Acts as a role model to other employees and always presents oneself as a credit to Harrah’s and encourages others to do the same.

- Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Director Of Finance
jobs.description:
The Director of Finance manages/supervises all accounting and casino financial operations and activities.  To accurately and promptly produce financial schedules and analysis of revenues, expenses, and capital expenditures.  Responsible for the development and maintenance of labor control activities; ensures accurate processing of payroll and all applicable taxes and reports are filed in accordance with federal, state and local law.  Assists in the establishment of production standards and goals; assist in developing departmental policies and procedures for the accomplishment of business objectives.
Starting Salary: $120,000 per year based on experience
- Demonstrated knowledge of accounting software systems.

- Demonstrated ability to perform a variety of mathematical computations, statistical reporting and analysis, budgeting and forecasting.

- Demonstrated experience performing with specific deadlines or under pressure.

- Demonstrated experience problem solving, and organizing and prioritizing work.

- Demonstrated effective and diplomatic oral and written communication skills. Strong Excel skills a must .

- Bachelor's Degree in Accounting Required.

- CPA / graduate degree preferred or the equivalent in education and experience. Eight (8) or more years of recent and related accounting experience, with five (5) years of managerial experience.

- Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.

- Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.

- Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public .

- Must be able to obtain a Colorado Limited Gaming Key License.
- Responsible for the coordination and preparation of the annual Business Plan and the preparation of financial schedules supporting the monthly operating reports.

- Ensures the effective management of the following casino and accounting operations: Revenue accounting, general ledger, accounts payable, payroll and count team, guest services/cage, and receiving team.

- Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

- Encourages staff to consistently demonstrate a general awareness of payroll and general ledger activity at all times.

- Performs all responsibilities in compliance with: various federal, state, and local regulations and changes in regulations, the Colorado Limited Gaming Act, and departmental policies and procedures.

- Coordinates monthly accounting close cycle at property level.

- Coordinates financial reporting on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.

- Analyzes variances to budget and forecast with follow-up to team leaders.

- Ensures company has adequate internal controls.

- Manages capital project expenditures with purchasing, finance, and other leaders.

- Provides financial analysis and support of various projects and decisions.

- Responsible for the financial analysis for the company, budgeting and forecasting , state gaming.

- Statistical reporting, and managing of Capital Expenditures.

- Manages the various internal and external audit processes during the fiscal year, including but not limited to the Division of Gaming audits, Colorado State sales & use tax audits, payroll and tip audits, compliance audits etc.

- Ensures accurate and timely filing of all casino and finance reports; payroll, state gaming taxes and supporting documentation, casino revenue reports, W2-G payments, property tax returns, and the filing of various annual returns.

- Within the realm of the responsibility of the job, maintains a clean and safe work environment.

- Complies with established security policies and procedures.

- Performs other duties, including special projects, as needed and directed.

jobs.title: Director of Finance - (Horseshoe Hammond)
jobs.description:
Responsible for the internal control accounting process, Warehouse, Cage and Count Room. Ensures compliance with existing and established company reporting policies and procedures and with the regulations and mandates of all governing bodies, both internal and external to the organization. Directly responsible for Financial Accounting, Revenue Audit, Cost Control, Cage, Count Room, Marine Ops, Facilities, and Warehouse.
- Must be 21 years of age or older
- Proficient in English verbal and written
- BA/BS in Accounting / Finance (or related field) required.
- Specific knowledge of all phases of the casino accounting cycle.
- Includes professional appearance and impeccable integrity and excellent problem-solving skills.
- Strong analytical skills
- Minimum ten (10) years accounting and supervisory experience.
- Strong computer skills.
- Ability to lead and monitor multiple projects
- Excellent decision-making and problem-solving skills.
- Strong organization skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks.
- Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees.
- Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
- Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
- Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals
- Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret all types of graphs.
- Must be able to work varying shifts including holidays, nights, and weekends.
- Ability to work with confidential data required.
- Must qualify for, obtain, and maintain a gaming license from the Indiana Gaming Commission, if applicable.
-  Access to the vessel is required.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
- Must be able to bend, reach, stoop, twist, stretch, and crouch repeatedly.
- Must be able to lift and carry objects up to 25 lbs.
- Must able to stand/walk throughout your scheduled shift.
- Must be able to work while in a seated position.
- Must be able to work in a loud/smoky environment.
- Must be able to work in area with hot/cold temperatures.
- Must be able to operate basic office equipment.
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office programs (I.E Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)
- Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
-  Reports directly to the SVP & GM and is responsible for the accuracy and efficiency in the preparation of all Financial Statements.
- Maintains and controls all financial records, reports and files to ensure their confidentiality and safekeeping.
- Ensures that all Financial Accounting, Revenue Audit, Cost Control, Cage and Count Room employees are trained to perform their duties in an efficient and effective manner.
- Assists in the timely preparation and interpretation of financial information for the property, including financial statements, budgets, forecasts, daily financial information and other financial data, after obtaining input from Operating Management as required.
- Ensure compliance with the established internal controls required to safeguard the property assets and to safeguard its integrity utilizing the Company guidelines.
- Responsible for monitoring expenses against a monthly operating budget as well as creating an annual departmental operating budget.
- Responsible for the annual company audit during both interim and final audit work.
- Provides timely and accurate support to all operating departments as needed.
- Reviews the work of staff to assure that duties assigned are performed in compliance with Company guidelines.
- Responsible for proactively identifying and implementing process improvements to streamline and gain accuracy.
- Responsible for the development of all direct reports.
- Support and maintain Horseshoe policy and procedures.
- Promote outstanding guest relations.
- Directly supervises financial accounting, revenue audit, Marine Ops, Facilities, and Warehouse Supervisor, and indirectly responsible for those departments.
- Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the company's policies and applicable laws.
- Responsibilities include interviewing, training, selecting and adjusting rates of pay and hours of work, directing the work of employees, maintaining production, appraising employees’ productivity and efficiency for purposes of recommending promotions or other changes (evaluations), handling employees’ grievances and complaints, disciplining employees, planning work, providing for safety and security, and monitoring or implementing legal compliance matters.
- Perform all other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Hotel Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Hotel Operations Manager plays a key leadership role in driving an exceptional guest experience and ensuring all hotel operations run seamlessly. This position oversees both front‑of‑house and back‑of‑house departments, partnering closely with team leaders to maintain service excellence, operational efficiency, financial performance, and brand standards.
We’re seeking a hospitality leader who thrives in a dynamic, people‑centered environment and enjoys elevating the guest experience through coaching, collaboration, and proactive problem‑solving. The ideal candidate is dedicated to fostering a positive culture, supporting staff development, and creating memorable stays through consistent operational excellence.
- Previous experience in hotel operations or hospitality leadership. - Prefer experience working in a casino hotel.

- Strong understanding of hotel departments, guest service standards, and operational workflows.
- Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills.
- Ability to lead diverse teams and foster a positive work environment.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Advanced knowledge of and experience with hotel management systems. - Prefer experience working with LMS.

- Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and operational financials.
- Hospitality or business-related education or certification.
- Provide overall leadership and oversight of hotel operations, ensuring efficient performance while maintaining appropriate staffing levels.
- Deliver an exceptional guest experience by addressing guest concerns, leading service recovery efforts, and driving initiatives that enhance satisfaction and service quality.
- Recruit, train, coach, and develop team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and service excellence.
- Support financial and administrative operations through budgeting, forecasting, payroll management, cost-control initiatives, KPI monitoring, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Maintain property standards by overseeing maintenance activities, safety procedures, inspections, cleanliness, brand standards, and vendor relationships to ensure a safe, welcoming, and well-maintained environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Casino Operations Manager-Table Games-Full Time (Harrah's Ak-Chin Casino)
jobs.description:
The Assistant Casino Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring and supervising the daily gaming floor operations on a specific shift, ensuring that courteous and prompt service is provided by all employees.  In the absence of the Executive for the casino shift, this position may be responsible for overall operation and safety of the property.  Keeps Casino Operations Manager informed of any pertinent information.
- High school diploma, G.E.D. or equivalent is required.

- Possess strong supervisory and leadership skills.

- Knowledge of casino rules, regulations and procedures pertinent to Casino Operations required.

- 1-year previous experience in gaming operations required.

- Three years’ previous supervisory experience required.

- Demonstrated ability to get along with co-workers and work as a team across departments and levels of management.

- Must be flexible and able to work all shifts as needed.

- Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

- Present a well-groomed appearance.

- Exhibits sound, decision-making qualities; motivates personnel; exhibits effective supervisory skills.

- Possesses a thorough working knowledge of the various games and equipment.

- Does routinely strive to build and maintain rapport with customers by handling disputes and making every effort to achieve customer satisfaction.

- Exercises appropriate discretion in identifying situations that require management attention.

- Is familiar with the federal currency transaction reporting guidelines and implements the same.

- Must project professionalism and possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Must be able to maneuver to all areas of the casino.

- Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds.

- Must be able to bend, reach, kneel, twist and grip items.

- Must be able to walk and be on foot for long periods of time.

- Must have sense of urgency and keep up with fast-paced business practices.

- Must be able to work calmly and professionally in stressful situations.

- Must be able to tolerate areas containing secondary smoke, high noise levels, bright lights and dust.

- Must be able to respond to visual and aural cues.
- Is directly responsible for training supervisors in technical and leadership skills for functions on/off casino floor.

- Is directly responsible for training gaming operations’ line employees, providing each with the knowledge and appropriate direction to perform his/her responsibilities.

- Observes, verifies and supervises all activities within the gaming area assigned, countersigning jackpot checks where appropriate.

- Oversee all significant monetary exchanges to ensure prompt and accurate execution of every transaction.

- Completes daily personnel assignments and reassigns personnel on floor based on business volume.

- Is responsible for key control and documentation.

- Builds a rapport and coordinates daily functions with support services departments, especially Marketing.

- Coordinates with Security to detect and prevent attempts to cheat or damage gaming equipment and to identify floor irregularities with the Casino Operations Manager.

- Ensures timely and accurate evaluations are given to direct reports with appropriate development plans, providing each with clear directives needed to meet departmental standards and achieve departmental and company goals.

- When acting as the manager on duty of the property: Is responsible for making decisions appropriate to the situation, initiates the notification of the Senior Team, and coordinates the reactive efforts of all personnel (all departments) until a Senior Team member arrives.

- Acts as role model; always presents oneself as a credit to Harrah’s and encourages others to do the same.

- Adheres to regulatory, departmental and company policies.

- Acts as a role model to other employees and always presents oneself as a credit to Harrah’s and encourages others to do the same.

- Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Restaurant Operations Manager - Multi-Outlet (Caesars New Orleans)
jobs.description:
The Restaurant Operations Manager is responsible for the overall management of all customer relationships and daily operations of multiple outlets on property.
- Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business Management, or related field preferred.
- Minimum five years of experience in full-service upscale or fine dining restaurant operations, with multi-unit or multi-outlet experience preferred.
- Proven leadership experience in front-of-house management within a high-volume, high-touch environment.
- Strong knowledge of service standards, OpenTable reservations systems, guest relations, and floor operations.
- Familiarity with food and beverage financials, including labor management and cost controls.
- Exceptional leadership, communication, and team development skills.
- Demonstrated ability to deliver elevated guest experiences and effectively resolve service challenges.

GAMING PERMIT: N/A
- Lead and oversee front-of-house operations across multiple full-service, upscale dining outlets, ensuring a seamless and elevated guest experience.
- Maintain exceptional service standards, with a strong presence on the floor to drive hospitality, service flow, and guest satisfaction.
- Partner with culinary and beverage leadership to deliver cohesive and consistent food and beverage experiences across assigned venues.

- Manage daily operations, including reservations, service execution, guest recovery, and floor management.
- Monitor staffing levels, scheduling, and labor deployment to ensure efficiency while maintaining service standards.

- Uphold and enforce service, presentation, and brand standards; proactively address and resolve any deviations.
- Analyze outlet performance, including labor and revenue trends, to drive operational improvements and financial results.
- Develop and implement FOH procedures, service standards, and training programs aligned with upscale dining expectations.

- Lead, coach, and mentor service teams, building a culture of professionalism, accountability, and hospitality excellence.
- Manage performance, including coaching, counseling, and conducting regular evaluations.
- Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation standards, maintaining a safe and polished environment for guests and team members.
- Collaborate with leadership on special events, VIP experiences, and operational initiatives across outlets.
- Act as a visible leader and ambassador of Caesars, consistently modeling professionalism and high service standards.

jobs.title: Assistant Hotel Operations Manager - (The Vanderpump Hotel LV)
jobs.description:
The Assistant Hotel Manager reports to and collaborates with the Hotel Operations Manager to set the tone for the front-of-house and back-of-house guest experience of The Cromwell.  This integral role assists in leading the hotel departments (Front Office, Front Services, Housekeeping, Environmental Services and Wardrobe) by example, ensuring that no need goes unmet and no opportunity to make a guest visit special is missed.
- Must be 21 years of age or older
- Strong knowledge of hotel operations and guest service standards.
- Ability to lead and support teams in delivering exceptional guest and team member experiences.
- Ability to balance daily operational demands with long-term business objectives.
- Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and multi-tasking environment.
- Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Presence should be as regular in the lobby, guest room on floors, throughout the casino area and at the front desk as it is in the office.
- Hands-on leadership style with a willingness to work alongside team members.
- Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to maintain a visible presence throughout the property and engage with guests and team members.
- Ability to receive feedback, adapt, and drive continuous operational improvement.
- Must comply with all departmental, property, and company policies and procedures.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
- Previous experience working with property management systems such as Opera, Infor, REX, and/or LMS.
- Proven track record of effectively communicating and presenting information to corporate and property leadership.
- Assist in leading hotel operations to deliver exceptional guest and team member experiences.
- Support the day-to-day management of hotel operations while helping achieve long-term operational and service goals.
- Maintain a strong understanding of all hotel division functions and provide hands-on operational support as needed.
- Partner with hotel leadership to ensure consistent delivery of outstanding guest service and a positive, high-performing team culture.
- Actively engage with guests and team members by maintaining a visible presence throughout the property, including the lobby, guest room floors, casino areas, front desk, and other operational areas.
- Monitor service standards, address operational challenges, and take proactive action to enhance the overall guest experience.
- Foster a collaborative work environment by working alongside team members and supporting operational success through coaching, guidance, and leadership.
- Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
- Solicit, evaluate, and act on guest and team member feedback to continuously improve services, processes, and operational performance.
- Ensure compliance with all departmental, property, and corporate policies, procedures, and service standards.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: General Manager - Gordon Ramsay Burger (Planet Hollywood LV)
jobs.description:
The Restaurant Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the outlet including, but not limited to employee relations and developing and implementing objectives in accordance with budgetary and service requirements.
- Must have a positive and professional interaction with all casino/hotel departments.
- Consistently demonstrates excellent communication and facilitation skills.
- Assists co-workers as needed.
- Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook E-mail programs.
- High school diploma or equivalent required. College degree preferred.
- Minimum five years high-volume Food and Beverage experience.
- Minimum three years supervisory experience.
- Must be congenial and have neat, professional appearance with good personal hygiene.
- Must be reliable and conscientious.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Possess the ability to interact (in English) with guests, co-workers and supervisory staff.
- Must be accuracy and detail oriented.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
- Ability to act quickly and exercise good judgment under pressure and/or conflict situations.
- Knowledge of current PC software including word processing and spreadsheets.
- Proficiency in Point of Sales systems (i.e. Micros, Infogenesis)
- Maintains high levels of customer satisfaction by building relationships with the guests (through table touches, greetings or warm farewells) and encourages employees to build relationships with the guests. Resolves customer complaints and/or service deficiencies by listening to the guest, responding with sincerity, and using appropriate service recovery tools. Uses tools such as Avero to analyze business trends and employee performance.
- In conjunction with the Food and Beverage Operations Director, develops ideas to maximize revenue and/or reduce expenses, outlining goals and objectives.
- Making sure that the restaurant and/or bar are in compliance with the Health Department Regulations and Standards and maintain the “A” grade. Knowledge of Health Department Rules and Regulations.
- Maximizes employee morale through leading by example in demonstrating Spotlight 5 behaviors to both guests and employees and provides the tools, guidance and support needed to enable all restaurant employees to give world class guest service.
- Conducts individual and team QIT, CIP’s, EOS/SFS, Step 1 and Buzz sessions and uses the Harrah's coaching cycle in giving both positive and corrective feedback.
- Follows and enhances departmental and restaurant specific policies, procedures and sequence of service.
- Additional duties as requested by the Food and Beverage Director.

jobs.title: VIP Hotel Operations Manager - Full Time (Caesars Palace LV)
